SAME.note: the probed star did change; answering SAME means the colour was not held in visual working memory (a miss)

CHANGED.note: the probed star changed colour

spec.partialCredit: a single probe is dichotomous; polytomous information for this type comes from the recognition shell and from the set-size ladder
